population.source: all V3 v3_final_candidate gap-level rows under the minimum structural contract
population.duplicate_entry_collapse: for exact duplicate entry_id rows choose larger strict_gap_width_pct, then lexical gap_id; never use outcome

prebreak_dryup_3_20.source: PIT turnover_fraction from V3 daily state where current_valid and finite nonnegative
prebreak_dryup_3_20.clock: completed valid stock sessions with trade_date strictly before reclaim_date
prebreak_dryup_3_20.recent3: three most recent completed valid sessions
prebreak_dryup_3_20.reference17: seventeen completed valid sessions immediately before Recent3
prebreak_dryup_3_20.coverage: missing unless exactly 20 valid completed sessions and positive Reference17 median

prebreak_compression_5.last2: two most recent completed valid sessions
prebreak_compression_5.prior3: three completed valid sessions immediately before Last2
prebreak_compression_5.coverage: missing unless exactly five valid completed sessions and positive Prior3 median

same_date.residual: event return minus same-board same-date median
same_date.tertiles: stable ordinal rank by lower PreBreakDryup, then larger StrictGapWidthPct, symbol, gap_id; floor(3*ordinal/N)

controlled_diagnostic.method: within-board signal-date demeaning then standardized OLS without intercept

chronological_test.training_use: bookkeeping only; no fitted threshold, parameter, or model
chronological_test.suffocation_ranker: valid lower PreBreakDryup first, then larger StrictGapWidthPct
chronological_test.signal_processing: causal first-cross timestamp order; ranking only among simultaneously available candidates
chronological_test.year_boundary: entry admitted only when legal exit is no later than test-year terminal session

subgroups.panic_quantiles: board-specific full-Development breadth Q75/Q90, predictor-only and diagnostic-only
subgroups.summary_contrast: fixed extreme dryup bins <=0.30 minus >1.00; no subgroup selection

verdict_rule.pooled_support: event-weighted and date-equal T1-open <=0.30 minus >1.00 contrasts are both positive
verdict_rule.same_date_support: combined board/date-equal low-tertile minus high-tertile T1-open return and mean daily Spearman are both positive
verdict_rule.chronological_support: sum of Main and ChiNext stitched suffocation-minus-base total-return differences is positive
verdict_rule.MARKET_REGIME_PROXY: pooled_support but neither same_date_support nor chronological_support
verdict_rule.DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY: pooled_support and exactly one of same_date_support or chronological_support, or same-date/chronological directions conflict materially by board
verdict_rule.NO_INFORMATION: pooled_support is false and neither same_date_support nor chronological_support
